snippet.title: Rob Run - Official Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out the Cinematic Trailer for Rob Run, an upcoming third-person crime extraction shooter developed by KEFIR. Players will explore a crime-filled sandbox to pull off heists, control territory, and pull off the great escape. Make off like bandits at all costs in Rob Run, coming soon to PC (Steam).

#IGN #Gaming
